evidence.quote: प्रोसेस एक चलता हुआ प्रोग्राम है जिसकी अपनी अलग मेमोरी होती है
evidence.comment: Accurately defines a process and its memory independence.

evidence.quote: सभी थ्रेड एक ही मेमोरी शेयर करते हैं, इसलिए थ्रेड बनाना सस्ता है
evidence.comment: Mentions shared memory and lower creation cost, but lacks context on use cases or synchronization.

strengths: Clear explanation of process vs thread memory model
Correctly notes that threads are lighter to create
improvements: Mention real-world use cases where multithreading is preferred
Add details about context switching overhead or race conditions
